title: Kagamine Rin — First Thunder〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake
That's a nice song.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you want...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
Just keep singing like I'm not here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're lying.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You never talk to anyone without a reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's very sharp of you.
Then, let's just get this out of the way then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I heard about that thunderstorm.
It was quite spectacular, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heard? From who...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We began by talking about how you two went over to see Mafuyu, but then that thunderstorm came up...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Knowing about them is one thing, but to actually experience one firsthand. I was hoping you could tell me more about it, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Did Len tell her that I was scared by it?
Doesn't he realize that all she'd do is come over to tease me...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If Len already told you everything, then I have nothing to add.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? But isn't it always best to ask an eyewitness?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I knew that she was just here to tease me...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (What if I explained how loud that thunder was...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (She might understand why I was so startled...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what was it like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Incredible.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The curtains and windows were all shut, but I could still see the sky flash.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As soon as that happened, this huge rumble followed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And then the sky flashed again. But this time, the rumble was so loud that it practically shook the ground.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then that means the thunderclouds must've been very close.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was so startled that I couldn't help but squat down. It was so loud...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that so?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't realize just how big that thunderstorm was, Rin. I can see why you were so scared.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wasn't scared. I was just surprised is all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, we can leave it at that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, thank you for telling me.
Your story was very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Nod*
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew...
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
There's something I forgot to mention.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When I spoke to Len, he simply told me that you mentioned there was a day when the thunder was really loud.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means...
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew I should've just ignored you, Luka...
